# Code of Conduct
> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)

## Our standard

We want technical discussion around this project to be precise, respectful, and useful. Contributors, reviewers, maintainers, and users are expected to:

- discuss ideas and evidence rather than attack people;
- give reproducible technical context when reporting problems;
- accept correction when evidence contradicts an earlier assumption;
- respect different experience levels, languages, backgrounds, and communication styles;
- avoid harassment, threats, discriminatory language, sexualized attention, doxxing, or deliberate disclosure of private information;
- keep security-sensitive material out of public issues and follow `SECURITY.md`.

## Scope

This standard applies in repository issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions about the project, and project-related communication where someone is representing the project or its community.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit, hide, lock, or remove content that violates this standard and may restrict participation when necessary to protect the project community. Enforcement decisions should be proportional, documented where appropriate, and focused on restoring a productive technical environment.

For conduct concerns that should not be handled publicly, contact `Đăng Khoa <i.am@dangkhoa.dev>`.
